title: Zaldo Co’s alleged ex-bodyguard takes withness stand in Romualdez bail hearing
summary: The prosecution presented an alleged former bodyguard of former lawmaker Rep. Zaldy Co as a witness in the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez on Monday.
